narrationTexts: Confirms exactly the 3 order-total cases predicted. Applying the fix.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the original price instead of the discounted price, so tax and discount got applied independently rather than tax-on-discounted-amount.

Changed `tax = roundCents(cents * taxRate)` to `tax = roundCents(discounted * taxRate)`.

Next: nothing, all 625 cases pass.
